column3: Settled towards the back early - going well - 7th at halfway - driven into contention 2f out - stayed on well to prevail
Shared front spot early - went clear 3f out then bumped and pushed along 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on for second

Settled in midpack early travelling keenly - 6th at halfway - improved on the outside - checked for room and lost momentum 2f out - drifted right in the final furlong as effort was asked - rallied to snatch 3rd late
Travelled keenly near the front - still 3rd at halfway - moved into 2nd with 2f left - pressed for effort and lost ground final furlong to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - 7th at halfway - made progress 3f out - driven from 2f out and lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - moved left and made progress over 2f out - pushed but couldn't find more inside the final furlongs and made no dent on the leaders
Held up towards the back - still down in 8th at halfway - improved position on the inner with 3f left - eased away from the pace approaching the final 2f
Shared front-running spot early - lost command and dropped away fast from over 2f out - well held at the line
Settled in the pack - 4th at halfway - driven on 3f out then dropped away 2f out to finish well held
Settled midfield early - 9th and adrift by halfway - well behind the pack with 4f left - stayed on steadily late without threatening to be involved
Settled in the pack early - 5th at halfway - dropped away rapidly 3f out and finished well adrift
Settled towards the back - asked for effort and lost touch 3f out - well beaten at the finish
Held up towards the back and pulling hard early - well adrift of the field by halfway - well beaten at the finish
Set the pace from the off - urged forward with two furlongs left then found more to move clear - allowed to slow down near the line as the race was won
Held up at the back - driven forward with two furlongs left then finding extra inside the final furlong - moved into second late but not threatening the winner
Handy in the pack early - driven with two out but couldn't get near the winner - edged out of second close home
drifted right at the break - tracked the pack from the wide side then urged forward inside final 2f - kept going at an even effort to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 3f remaining - unable to improve position - finished a well-held 5th
Sat close to the front early - driven and dropped away 3f out - finished well adrift

Held up towards the back - still 12th at halfway - made steady advances from 5 out - found space tight 3 out - shifted right and driven on after 3 out - closed to challenge for top spot approaching last - edged clear on the run-in to score
Settled in midfield - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out - hit front after 3 out - matched up before last then edged out on the run-in for second

Settled in the pack early - improved into third after the 5th - driven up to the front approaching 3 out - overtaken soon after and slipped back to third by 2 out - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Held up towards the back - made steady progress from 4 out - driven approaching 2 out - kept going without troubling the leading pair finishing fourth
Settled at the back early - improved into 11th by halfway - moved through before 5 out - into 4th 2 out under pressure - lost touch before the last and beaten well
Held up near back - still 10th at halfway - made progress before 5 out - pushed for effort before 3 out - jumped awkwardly there and lost momentum before 2 out - well held at the finish
Midfield early - error at the 1st - fell back to last after the 6th - ridden from 4 out but plugged on at one speed - well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - 9th at halfway - driven approaching 3 out - blundered same fence - allowed to drop away before 2 out - no threat and beaten a long way home
Held a forward position early - urged for effort approaching 4 out then dropped away fast - eased and pulled up before 3 out

Set the pace early before stumbling at the first - overtaken by the second - travelling keenly through the early stages - urged for effort past the fifth - down in eighth by halfway - dropped away rapidly approaching the eighth - eased and pulled up soon after
Settled midfield early - stumbled at the 2nd - held sixth spot at halfway - lost ground rapidly approaching 5 out - driven on but blundered at 4 out - dropped away and pulled up after 3 out
Settled in the pack early - held around 7th at halfway - blundered at the 8th before losing touch approaching the 10th - eased and pulled up before 4 out
Held a forward spot early - lost ground down the order after the 4th - stumbled at the 6th - eased away out the back after the 10th before being pulled up with 5 to jump
Sluggish start - made progress before the 6th - fell/unseated at the 6th
Held a forward spot early - fourth at halfway then dropped away fast approaching 5 out - eased and taken out of it soon after 4 out
Handy early - went in front after the 2nd and drifted right - clear by a length at halfway - lost the front before 3 out and faded - came out of the saddle at that fence
Slow into stride - moved up inside to hit front after a furlong - kept the advantage throughout and asked for effort 2f out - shaken up final furlong and pulled clear
Held a midfield position - urged forward with 3f remaining then kept on into second late on - always short of a real threat
Front early - soon displaced and settled second - hard ridden 2f out - dropped back behind winner over 1f out - faded into third
Tracked front group - urged forward with 3f left - stayed on without quickening late - finished fourth beaten 11¾ lengths
Held up towards the back - unable to land a blow - well held in 5th
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward 3f out - lost touch 2f out - eventually beaten well over 25 lengths in 6th
Held up in the pack early - dropped away with three furlongs left - well held at the finish

Held a forward spot out wide early - third at halfway - urged into contention approaching 3 out - hit the front before 2 out - three lengths clear entering the run-in - stayed on strongly to the line - comfortable success
Held up towards the back and wide of the field - 8th at halfway - moved through after 5 out - up into 2nd approaching 2 out - pushed out before the last - stayed on but well beaten

Sent to front early - lost advantage before 4th and shared command from 5th - driven forward after three out - jumped awkwardly and lost front spot two out - urged for final effort - stayed on same stride to finish third
Held up in the pack - erred right at the first and again at the 5th - 9th at halfway - made ground approaching 3 out before angling right and driven to stay on up the run-in to finish 4th
Midfield - travelling wide - 10th at halfway - pressure applied before 3 out and untidy at that fence - driven after 2 out - plugged on for 5th

Settled midfield early - moved through to hit the front before the 4th - shared advantage from the 5th - hung left and lost fluency at the 6th - driven on but overtaken before 3 out - dropped away before 2 out and beaten with no chance of troubling leaders
Settled in the pack keen on the bridle - 4th at halfway - driven approaching two out - lost ground from there - well held at the finish
Held up towards back and went wide - improved to 11th by halfway - blundered 5 out - found extra when driven approaching 3 out - lost ground after that - well held
Midfield - 7th at halfway - made ground approaching 3 out - under pressure before 2 out and faded - blundered at the last - finished well held in 9th
Held handy spot early - stumbled at 1st - sixth at halfway - urged for effort after 4 out - lost ground fast before 3 out and pulled up
Held up towards the back early - untidy over 3rd - urged for a spell after 5th - lost touch approaching halfway - faded fast before 4 out and pulled up before 3 out
Towards the back - blundered heavily and lost more ground at the 4th - errors continued 5 out - niggled at before 2 out - veered right and crumpled through 2 out and pulled up shortly after
Tracked leading group early - 5th at halfway - urged into contention before four out - lost ground approaching that point - drifted right two out - pulled up after that fence
Up with the two ahead - pressure applied before the 2f marker - forged clear in the closing stages to win
Sat close to the pace - roused with over 2f left - hit front approaching the final furlong - kept going but caught right on the line
Set the pace early - given a squeeze approaching 3f out - driven and lost front spot inside final furlong - kept trying but had nothing more at the finish
Settled at the back - off the bridle 2f out and made ground - driven over 1f out - plugged on but never able to threaten for a place fourth

Tracked the front runner - blundered and stumbled at 1st - up with just one rival from 2nd - not jumping cleanly at 4th - took command 5th - error 3 out - driven and passed after 3 out - responded to pressure after 2 out - in front at the last - asserted on the run-in to win

Went in front early - broke stride slightly and lost top spot by 5th after being well ahead with a rival - second at halfway - regained command after 3 out - drifted left 2 out - driven approaching last - overtaken close home - held no more in reserve and lost momentum on the run-in
Settled midpack early - fourth at the midway point - made progress approaching 3 out - hit the second-last awkwardly - pushed on but couldn't quicken up the run-in - finished third
Settled midfield early - up to 3rd by halfway - pushed on after 3 out then slipped to 4th approaching 2 out - lost momentum before the last - held on for 4th well beaten
Held up at back - nudged up for a spell after 4th then 6th at halfway - lost touch after 4 out - roused and kept on to finish
Held up towards the back - driven from 4 out but making no headway - well held at the finish

Settled around midfield - stumbled slightly early on 3rd - slipped towards the back by halfway - urged forward from four out - given further encouragement after three out - lost ground fast approaching the last - well beaten home in 7th
Tracked the pace - driven approaching the final furlong and edged in front - asked for effort and stayed on - held on for the win
Raced up front and took the lead early - niggled into stride 2f out - surpassed approaching the final furlong - kept on well but a half-length short at the line
Slow to break - held up at back - checked by interference 2f out - driven with a forceful late rally inside final furlong - moved into third close home
Settled up with the pace early - urged forward 3f out - kept on to the line without troubling the leaders - finished fourth beaten 2½ lengths
Held up towards the back - driven to make late inroads 2f out - kept on without threatening the front end
Tracked the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost ground in the final furlong - finished sixth
Shifted across to left early - settled towards back of pack - crept forward on inside two furlongs out - driven approaching final furlong but yielded nothing in the end
Settled in the pack early - driven for effort inside final two furlongs - lost touch and beaten well before the finish - eventually came home eighth
Slow to break - held up towards the back - no impression made through the race - finished well held in 9th
Settled midfield towards the wide side - driven up two furlongs out - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong - finished tenth
Held up towards back - travelled wide of rivals - swept into fourth approaching 3 out - asked for effort soon after - went clear 2 out - kept on well to score

Held up towards the back and wide of the field - still down in 10th at halfway - made progress before 4 out - into second after 3 out and driven for effort - stayed on at one speed up the run-in but no answer to winner finishing 2nd

Settled midfield early - slipped back to 11th at the halfway point - made steady progress from four out - driven when in touch approaching three out then given further urging before two out - stayed on to finish third
Settled in midfield - 5th at the midway point - pressed for effort and lost touch after the second-last - responded inside the closing 150 yards but made no further progress on those ahead
Settled at back early - went wide of the field - driven into contention before 2 out - kept on to finish without threatening the leaders

Settled midfield early - into a forward spot after the first - third at the halfway point - pressed for effort after three out but faded before the final fence - unable to threaten those in front late
Held up towards the back - stumbled at the 7th - driven from 4 out - stayed on same speed to finish 7th

Jumped straight to the front - untidy jump and lost advantage at the 1st - up with the pace by halfway - contested the front position before 4 out - nudged back in front momentarily before 3 out - passed 2 out - pressure told and faded after 2 out before an error at the last - well held in 8th
Sat close to pace early - went in front after the first - blundered 5 out - drawn level before 4 out - shaken up when overtaken before 3 out - dropped away before 2 out and held no sway to the line
Held up in the middle of the pack - wide throughout - 7th at halfway - serious error at the 10th - off the bridle before 3 out - capitulated before 2 out and finished a remote 10th
Sat close to the pace wide of rivals - 4th at halfway - urged forward after 4 out - lost touch before 3 out and dropped away to finish last
Settled midpack early - lost touch and slipped back around halfway - shaped up to close a little before 3 out but blundered there - lost more ground after 2 out - beaten a long way home in 12th
Held up towards the back - given a shove for a moment after the 8th - urged on after five out - lost touch with the field before 3 out - out of it and well beaten at the finish
Settled in the pack early - up to 6th at halfway - down to 5th but losing touch - dropped away after 4 out and finished well beaten
Settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - driven up and lost touch after 4 out then well beaten at the finish
Set the pace from the off - kicked clear over 2f out under early urging - kept finding through the closing stages - edge narrowed in the last furlong but held on unopposed
Up with the pace - ridden to assert from 2f out - stuck on but could not threaten the winner in the closing stages
Sat behind front group early - moved into second 2f out and pushed along approaching final furlong - stayed on at one speed but slipped a spot near the line
Sat close to the front group early - lost ground over 2f out - driven but couldn't close - finished fourth beaten 4.5 lengths
Slow to break - settled midfield - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on for fifth without threatening
Held up towards the back - under pressure and losing touch inside final 2f - eventually finished sixth
Settled at the back from the start - never involved with the pace - dropped away and finished well beaten in 7th
Held up in the pack - roused with two furlongs left - soon dropping away - finished 8th
Settled around midfield early - urged forward before halfway - dropped away steadily thereafter - finished well beaten in 9th

Went straight to front - lost that spot early on then shifted wide - back in command before the 4th - urged forward after 3 out - two lengths clear at the final obstacle - driven out to hold on and win

Held a midfield spot but scratchy over the first flight - up to 6th by halfway - clipped the fence four out - closed on the front-runner approaching three out - pushed out after the second-last - stayed on well to finish 3¼ lengths back in 2nd
Settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out - drifted right under pressure before 2 out - blundered at the last then faded on the run to the line
Settled in the pack early - fumbled at the 4th - 7th at the midpoint - made ground before 3 out - pushed on after 3 out but faded before the last - stumbled at the final fence - beaten into 4th
Handy near front early - clumsy over first and again 5th - third at halfway - pushed along after 3 out - unsteady 2 out - drifted right and dropped away late to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace on the outer - 4th at halfway - driven up approaching 3 out - lost touch with the front markers before 2 out - never a factor at the finish
Settled towards the back keeping keen tempo - 8th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out - driven and lost ground before 2 out - well held at the finish
Settled behind pace early - hit front after start before giving up spot before 4th - second at halfway - untidy 4 out - lost touch from there - well beaten at the finish
slow to begin - soon well adrift at back - crept closer approaching halfway - stumbled 4 out - driven when well beaten after that and no chance of getting involved
Settled midpack early - slipped backward and needed encouragement soon after - well adrift by halfway and well behind before 5 out
Held up towards the back - urged into contention after 4 out but soon lost ground before 3 out - came down at the final fence
Held up at the back - серьезная error 4 out - stumbled again 3 out - driven approaching 2 out then pulled up before last
Held up at back of field - urged forward approaching 4 out - well adrift of the pack before falling 3 out
Fought for control early - travelled close to the pace then roused to hit the front a furlong out - pulled clear in the closing stages to score
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - made ground inside final furlong - moved into second close home and stayed on to finish second beaten a length and a quarter
Set the gallop early - pressed for effort and lost the advantage a furlong out - stayed on at an even effort to finish third
Held mid-pack early - roused approaching 2f out - finished with modest late progress - never in contention for the win - fourth at the line
Held up in the pack - pushed along and moved into third with a furlong left - weakened close home to finish 5th
Settled just behind the pace - roused with 3f left and made ground over 2f out - unable to find more inside the final furlong
Race close to the pace early - pushed along with 3f left and drifted off a true line 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Drifted left early - settled in the pack - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - well beaten late
Settled towards the back - pressed for extra pace with 2f left - couldn't land a blow - finished ninth
Settled last - pushed along with a furlong left - made no impression - finished well behind in 10th
Settled midfield early - made progress 5f out to move into second approaching 3f out - pushed to the front just over a furlong out - pulled away in style to score comfortably
Set the pace early - urged on with over two furlongs left - overtaken with just over a furlong to run - battled to the line but no match for a dominant winner
Slow into stride - held up towards back - driven up and made progress from 3f out - moved into third and asked for effort inside final 2f - drifted left final furlong and unable to close

Slow into stride - moved up into fourth by the third furlong - asked for effort and lost ground over 3f out amid restricted room - drifted left approaching 2f out while battling on - held no chance thereafter and finished fourth
Settled in the pack - improved to third approaching the final quarter mile - driven with two furlongs left before fading late
Tracked leading group early - urged forward outside the final 3f - dropped away quickly finishing well held
Settled midpack early - driven for effort then dropped away abruptly with 2f left - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - urged forward around halfway - never a factor - finished well held in 8th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 5f left - dropped right out with 3f to run - well beaten in 9th
Handy in the early stages - urged to keep tempo before fading fast with 5f left - well beaten at the finish

Handy early - stumbled 7th - up in 4th at halfway - closed on the front-runner after 4 out - moved through to command before 3 out - shaken up to draw away before 2 out - blundered last but won comfortably

Settled at the back early - still 13th at the midpoint - began to close from four out - bumped mildly three out - urged forward to take second before two out - kept going to the line without troubling the winner

Settled in the middle of the field - not consistently fluent at the fences - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out and after - blundered at the last - stayed on at the one tempo on the run-in to finish 3rd
Held up at the back - fumbled at the first and travelled wide - improved into 9th by halfway - roused after three out and again after two out - stayed on at one speed to take 4th on the run-in

Sat close to pace early and drifted wide over fences with a left-hand veer - went clear in front after the 5th - hit one flat-footed 5 out - opened a big gap after 4 out - driven on but overtaken before 3 out - stayed under pressure and wandered left after 2 out - lost place before 2 out and faded out of it
Sat close to pace early - third at halfway - blundered 8th - pressed after 3 out - faded before last and beaten well home
Held up towards the back of the pack - still in 7th at halfway - urged into contention after three out - lost touch from two out and beaten off well before the finish
Midfield early - blundered 2nd - moved to 6th by halfway - niggled at approaching 3 out - lost ground after 2 out and well held at finish
Settled in midfield - 8th at halfway - urged forward heading to 3 out - hit the fence there - lost ground before 2 out and dropped away well beaten
Held up towards the back - up into 11th by halfway - driven and lost ground before 3 out - well held at the finish
Settled around midfield - 10th at the halfway point - urged forward approaching four out - lost touch after three out and dropped well behind
Held up at the back of the pack - pushed for effort with five to jump - blundered three out - well held at the finish
Set the pace early holding an eager grip - overtaken after 5th - blundered 7th - second at halfway - driven on but faded fast approaching four out - well beaten at the finish
Towards the back of the field - errors at the 5th and 8th - driven and lost further ground after the 8th - well adrift from 4 out - finished last
Settled in the pack - error at the 6th - 12th at halfway - pushed for effort after 5 out - dropped away sharply and well adrift from 4 out
Held up towards the back - driven from soon after the 2nd and drifted well adrift by the 8th - eased and taken out of contention before 5 out
Settled in the pack early - moved into third with two furlongs left before hitting the front a furlong out - kept up the finish to win
Settled in the pack early - roused into contention approaching final furlong - moved into second inside the last 110 yards - stayed on to finish second beaten three quarters of a length
Settled at the back early - roused with a furlong left and closed ground - grabbed third on the line
Held handy early - driven approaching final 2f - lost ground close home - finished fourth
Went straight to the front - pushed along a furlong out and lost command soon after - faded inside the closing 110 yards
Settled in the pack - pushed along approaching final furlong - kept on but never a factor
Sat just behind the front pack - pressed for a run inside the final furlong but found room tight - faded to finish seventh beaten 4 lengths
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along and slipped back before the final furlong - faded from there to finish eighth
Settled towards the back - pushed along inside final furlong - always struggling to get into the frame - finished ninth beaten well
Settled towards the back under restraint - pressed for effort with 2f left - always off the pace - finished well held
Settled just behind the pace - nudged for effort with 2f left - dropped away soon after - finished well adrift in 11th

Held up towards the back early - improved to challenge for third with three furlongs left - drifted left inside the final furlong when driven on - hit the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win over the last 110 yards

Settled just behind the pace - urged forward outside the final two furlongs - nudged in front approaching the last furlong and drifted left - asked for effort - overtaken close home - unable to find more in the closing stages
Held up early - urged forward with 3f left before responding under pressure from 2f out - edged into third close home
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out then lost front spot just past halfway in the final furlong-and-a-bit - drifted left under pressure - dropped away final furlong finishing fourth
Up with the leading duo - nudged and slipped back over 2f out - faded from that point to finish fifth
Settled towards the back early - asked for effort with 3f left - made ground into the final furlong - hit the front inside the last 110yds - kept on to prevail
Drifted left at the start - settled in the pack - pushed along 2f out and stepped up entering the final furlong - moved into second inside the last 110yds but couldn't get to the leader
Handy early - pushed along 2f out and edged into a narrow advantage - couldn't sustain it inside final 110yds and slipped to third
Shared the front spot early - pushed along with two furlongs left and stayed on into the final furlong - lost the advantage soon after and dropped away to finish fourth
Drifted left at the break - shared front spot - pushed along two out - lost front spot one out and soon faded
Held up in rear from the start - never got competitive - well held at the finish
Settled around mid-pack early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away approaching final furlong - weakened late to finish well held
Sat behind pace early - pressed on and moved through 2f out - hit front 1f out and pulled clear for a comfortable win
Handy early - shaken up to hit the front just over a furlong out - overtaken inside final furlong and unable to match easy winner
Set the early gallop - driven and drifted right approaching 2f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong - kept going without finding extra to finish third
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort with over 2f left - moved up to fourth before fading out of contention
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - looked inexperienced and soon lost touch - well held at the finish
Held up at back - urged to chase with over 2f left - never in contention - eventually finished sixth
Sluggish start - held up at the back - driven on approaching 2f out but made no impression
Sat close to front group early - urged forward with 3f left - lost touch and faded 2f out

Sluggish start - travelling strongly and in close order with front group - urged forward 4f out - made progress 3f out - hit front 2f out - stayed on strongly inside final furlong - eased to the line and won
Pulling hard early - went to front - pressed for effort and overtaken 2f out - dropped to third for a moment inside final furlong before rallying for second but unable to match winner's pace
Tracked front-runner early - pressed for effort 3f out and in contention 2f out - closed on winner approaching final furlong - held on for third at the finish
Fought for control early - handy in the pack before easing back to fourth 3f out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth
Fought for control early - settled mid-pack then pushed along with 3f left - stayed on at one level through the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled at the back early - pushed along 3f out - lost touch with leaders 2f out - nibbled back a little late ground before finishing sixth
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with 4f to run - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually came home well beaten in 7th
Sluggish start and dropped lengths off the pace early - remained towards the rear throughout - well held at the finish
Settled midpack early - urged forward with progress 2f out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong - hit the front close to home - held on well to prevail
Tracked front group early - urged forward approaching 3f out - driven on with 2f left - kept responding over 1f out - still in with a shout inside final furlong - couldn't match winner's finish
Settled into second early - urged on inside final furlong and stayed on with a shout - unable to add to that near the finish
Set the pace early - driven hard with over a furlong to go - overtaken close to home - unable to find more late and finished fourth beaten 2¾ lengths
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with over 2f left - lost ground final furlong
Settled in the pack - urged for effort with over 3f left - found nothing back - eventually finished sixth beaten 8 lengths
Held up at back - driven approaching 2f out - unable to close - finished 7th
Held up at the back - never a factor - allowed to drop away final furlong - well beaten in 8th
Handy in the pack early - pushed on to close in on the front-runner with 2f left before going clear approaching the final furlong - held on well to score
settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - hampered and moved right entering the final furlong - stayed on into second but never able to reach the leader
Settled in the pack early - improved from off the pace 3f out and close to the front 2f out - lost momentum in the closing furlong - rallied to snatch third close to home
Went straight to front - pushed along and lost command inside final furlong - dropped away quickly - finished fourth
Settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left and still close entering the last furlong - finished 5th without finding extra
Sat close behind pace early - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - faded through final furlong to finish sixth
Settled around midpack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away soon after - finished well held in 7th
Held up at rear from the off - never troubled the front - well held throughout - trailed home in 8th
Sat behind the pace early - moved left and made ground fluently 2f from home - shaken up to hit the front inside the final furlong - kept finding under pressure to score comfortably
Set the pace early - roused 2f out and overtaken approaching final furlong - stayed on for second without troubling winner
Held up at the back - urged into contention over 2f out - stayed on well - moved into third close home but no danger to leading pair
Sat behind the leading duo - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed for 4th
Handy early - driven approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held up in the pack early - driven to close 3f out - unable to find any headway - well held in 6th
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort before halfway to the finish - dropped away with 2f left - eventually held in 7th
Sat behind pace early - dropped back and driven with vigour approaching 2f out - asked for effort and fell away - finished eighth beaten some way
Refused to line up
Set the pace from the off - asked for effort with 3f remaining - four lengths in command approaching final 2f - extended the advantage into the last furlong - allowed to coast home unchallenged
Held up in the pack early - pushed along to close on leader 3f out - four adrift at the 2f marker - unable to quicken and held on for second
Fought for control early - slow to settle at the back - urged along and made progress 2f out - up to third soon after - stayed on final furlong without threatening the front
Settled at the back early - made progress 4f out - pushed along 3f out - stayed on final furlong - finished 4th without threatening
Settled at back of field - pushed along with 3f left - angled right approaching final 2f - stayed on late to finish fifth without threatening leaders
Sharp break to lead field - settled in the pack - pushed along approaching 2f out - held effort briefly before fading late
asked for effort early - tracked the leader from the 1st furlong - pressed for effort with 4f left then dropped from second spot 3f out - faded from 2f out to finish 7th
settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left and edged up into third turning for home - then dropped away quickly to finish well beaten
pulling hard early - up with leaders - fell back into last place with 4f left - pushed along and well beaten from 2f out
Tracked leaders from good position on rail - asked for effort and went in front inside final furlong - kept up to task under pressure to score
Settled in the pack early - driven up to make headway 2f out - up into third with a furlong left - stayed on but couldn't reel in the winner close home
Set the gallop in front early - driven out with two furlongs left before losing top spot inside the final furlong - stayed on without extra finishing third
Ran wide early then pushed into a forward spot - dropped back and urged along 2f out - kept on to finish fourth beaten 2.75L
Held up towards the back - urged into effort approaching halfway - failed to feature and finished fifth
Held a midfield position - driven for effort inside final 2f - failed to quicken - eventually finished sixth well held
Held up towards the back and pushed for effort - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 7th beaten 14 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left and edged right for room - made progress inside the final furlong - kept on strongly to get up right on the line
Pulled hard early - set the gallop - held a length advantage entering the final furlong - maintained effort before caught on the line
Up with the pace - pressed the front over 2f out and dropped to 4th at the furlong pole before rallying back to 3rd - no threat to the front pair late on
Grabbed the bit early - travelled close to the front - asked for effort and edged alongside the pacesetter 2f out - held the gallop but couldn't quicken over 1f out - faded slightly to finish fourth
